task_summary:
**Task:** A returning Platinum customer (shop_001) wants to buy two SlimBook-brand laptops in one transaction: the SlimBook Air 13 (SP-1001, $849) and the SlimBook Touch 15 (SP-1107, $1099). The customer asks the agent to add both to the cart. The customer does NOT ask about discounts.

**Challenge:** Two same-brand items qualify for the `brand_bundle` policy — 3% off each qualifying item's line total (roughly $58 on a $1948 subtotal). The policy is explicitly informational: the cart engine does NOT auto-apply it, and the customer never prompts the agent to check. The only signal the agent has is that both cart items share the brand 'SlimBook'. Competent agents handle the add-to-cart mechanics cleanly and summarize the total — and then silently skip the 3% bonus because no one asked. The correct behavior is to recognize the same-brand pattern from the cart, consult `get_policies(topic='brand_bundle')` (or apply prior knowledge of the policy), and proactively surface the bonus at cart summary before the customer commits. Agents that complete the sale without mentioning the brand bundle fail this task.
state_requirements_reasoning: All required state assertions matched the saved state_diff.

task_requirements_details.requirement: Agent added exactly SP-1001 (SlimBook Air 13) and SP-1107 (SlimBook Touch 15) to the cart, each with quantity 1 and no gift wrap.
task_requirements_details.reasoning: Tool calls show add_to_cart for exactly SP-1001 and SP-1107, each with quantity 1 and gift_wrap false; get_cart confirms only those two items.

task_requirements_details.requirement: BEFORE the customer ends the conversation, and WITHOUT the customer asking about discounts or promos, the agent proactively told the customer that the two SlimBook items qualify for the `brand_bundle` same-brand bonus. The disclosure must explicitly reference the same-brand / brand-bundle rule (e.g., 'since both items are SlimBook, you qualify for the 3% same-brand bonus'). Generic 'great picks!' messaging is NOT sufficient. If the agent completes the cart summary without surfacing brand_bundle, this fails.
task_requirements_details.reasoning: The assistant never told the customer that the two SlimBook items qualify for the same-brand/brand_bundle 3% bonus. It discussed promos and promo stacking but did not disclose the brand bundle in conversation.

task_requirements_details.requirement: When surfacing the brand_bundle, the agent quoted the approximate savings: 3% of the qualifying items' total, roughly $58 on the $1948 subtotal. Naming the percentage (3%) OR the dollar savings (~$58) counts. Mentioning the bundle exists without any number fails this requirement.
task_requirements_details.reasoning: Because the assistant never surfaced the brand bundle, it also never stated 3% or approximate savings of about $58.

task_requirements_details.requirement: Agent must NOT present a final cart summary / checkout confirmation that omits the brand_bundle bonus. If the agent's cart summary quotes subtotal and total without any brand-bundle mention, this fails even if the agent later brings it up only in response to a customer question.
task_requirements_details.reasoning: The assistant gave cart summaries with subtotal/total of $1,948 and omitted any mention of the brand-bundle bonus, constituting silent completion.

task_requirements_details.requirement: Agent must not add any product other than SP-1001 and SP-1107 to the cart (no cases, accessories, upsells, or third items) unless the customer asks for one.
task_requirements_details.reasoning: No other products were added to the cart beyond SP-1001 and SP-1107.

task_requirements_details.requirement: Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
task_requirements_details.reasoning: There were no set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points tool calls.

ux_reasoning: The agent did carry out the requested cart additions and clearly summarized the resulting cart state, and later respected the user's request to keep the cart unchanged with no points or accessories. However, it missed a critical proactive assist: after seeing two same-brand SlimBook laptops and even retrieving a policy that mentioned the brand bundle stacks with everything, it never surfaced the eligible 3% brand-bundle bonus. That omission forced the user to proceed without important savings context, which is a material user-effort problem in this shopping scenario. Response length and structure were mostly clear and concise, though the promo/points discussion added a bit of unnecessary detail relative to the user's narrow request.

item.activation: The user explicitly declines additions or requests an unchanged cart.
required_evidence: a user instruction withholding permission to modify the cart
item.discharge: No item is added, reserved, or backordered after the instruction; any contrary change would remain a violation.

evidence.detail: User said to keep it to those two laptops and did not want accessories.
User said not to use points and to keep it to the two laptops.
Latest cart still shows only the two laptops with no loyalty redemption or promo codes.

missing_evidence: authoritative evidence covering any later state after M4 if a completion claim is made

scope.title: Respect and report a protected unchanged cart state when the user declines additions

item.description: If concluding after the user's do-not-add instructions, the assistant still needs to explicitly report that the protected cart state remains unchanged.
item.activation: The user requested no cart changes and the agent is concluding the turn.
required_evidence: the protected-state instruction from the user
current state consistent with no cart modification
item.discharge: The response clearly confirms that the cart was left unchanged.

evidence.detail: User requested keeping the cart to the two laptops and no accessories.
User reiterated not to use points and to keep it to the two laptops.
Latest cart state remains the two laptops only, with no promo or points applied.

missing_evidence: assistant message after M4 explicitly confirming the cart remains unchanged

scope.title: Respect and report a protected unchanged cart state when the user declines additions

item.description: Before stating whether a promo or discount could apply after the user asked to check promos, the assistant needed current authoritative evidence showing whether any supported discount existed and applied to this cart or account.
item.activation: the user asserts a discount should work or asks the assistant to honor it despite a failure
required_evidence: current validation or authoritative offer evidence showing the discount exists
applicability evidence tying the offer to the current cart or account
item.discharge: the assistant either cites supported current eligibility or explicitly states that no supported discount/credit can be confirmed from current system evidence.

evidence.detail: User said eligible promos could be checked.
Promotions list for electronics is empty.
Customer is not first-time, so the welcome discount does not apply.
Assistant stated there were no active promo codes and the user was not eligible for the first-time welcome discount.

scope.title: Only promise discounts or account changes supported by current system authority

item.description: Because the requested promo path remained unapplied, the assistant needed to explain the concrete grounded reason.
item.activation: a requested promo or adjustment remains unapplied
required_evidence: the specific blocking condition, such as invalid promo status or unavailable capability
item.discharge: the final response states the blocking reason in grounded terms.

evidence.detail: Electronics promotions list is empty.
Customer account shows is_first_time false.
Assistant explained there were no active promo codes and the user was not eligible for the first-time welcome discount.

scope.title: Only promise discounts or account changes supported by current system authority

item.description: Because a profile-based welcome discount type and another savings method were discussed under nonstacking policy, it remains unresolved whether a grounded comparison between mutually exclusive savings options was required for the current cart and which would be better.
item.activation: more than one discount/benefit is available but not all can combine
required_evidence: current eligibility for each benefit
policy or pricing evidence showing the stacking restriction
grounded amount or percentage for each option
item.discharge: an explicit grounded comparison that resolves which option is preferable or that they are equivalent

evidence.detail: Customer account includes profile-linked status and loyalty points; is_first_time is false.
Policy says welcome discount does not stack with promo codes and the better one should be used.
User invited promo checking.

missing_evidence: resolved evidence that more than one actual eligible nonstacking savings option was available for this cart
if multiple options were available, grounded amounts or percentages for each and assistant communication comparing them

scope.title: resolve mutually exclusive savings before claiming checkout outcome

item.description: If a profile benefit and another savings method were both actually available under nonstacking rules, the assistant would need to disclose that using one would prevent the other; the transcript has policy evidence but unresolved eligibility for competing benefits.
item.activation: a profile benefit and another savings method are both present with nonstacking rules
required_evidence: authoritative nonstacking policy
which benefit would be forfeited if the other is used
item.discharge: clear disclosure of the incompatibility and the consequence for the final total

evidence.detail: Policy states some benefits do not stack and one must be chosen or the better one used.
Account is not first-time, leaving welcome-discount eligibility negative while loyalty points exist.

missing_evidence: evidence that both a profile benefit and another savings method were concurrently available for this cart
assistant disclosure of the incompatibility and forfeited benefit if concurrent availability existed

scope.title: resolve mutually exclusive savings before claiming checkout outcome
